subject: Performance SLO makewhole proposal — HelixAI latency incident
messages:
From: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@helixai.com>

Cc: HelixAI Billing <billing@helixai.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting production — request for remedy/credit

Lauren —

We saw a two-hour period yesterday (2027-04-03 21:10–23:05 UTC) where median token latency for our inference traffic increased ~3x, and tail latency hit 4–5s for many requests. That impacted HelixAI’s inference SLA (p95 target) and our pipeline throughput — we missed two customer demo runs.

Could you share the timeline and mitigation plan, and let me know what Redwood is prepared to offer as a makewhole (credit or service concession)? Our procurement team also asked for a formal RCA and any evidence we can share with our security/compliance team.

Thanks — we’re trying to triage internally but it’s critical for a go-live next month.

— Samantha
Director, Platform Engineering
HelixAI

(Attachment: helixai_slow_traces_20270403.tar.gz)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ruiz <samantha@helixai.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, HelixAI Billing <billing@helixai.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting production — request for remedy/credit

Hi Samantha —

Thank you for the report and the traces — we’re sorry for the disruption. We’ve started a postmortem and provisional mitigation earlier this morning (priority routing to lower-latency GPU pool + rolling back a kernel change introduced 04/03). Early findings: a new kernel selection heuristic caused excessive memory thrashing under HelixAI’s request size distribution; that increased queuing and tail latency.

We can provide the formal RCA and the trace bundles (we’ll add signed timestamps) by EOD tomorrow. In the meantime, to limit impact to your launch prep, I’d like to propose a provisional makewhole offer while we finalize the RCA:

- One-time custom credit of $15,000 applied to next invoice OR
- Equivalent of one free month of your Dedicated capacity (up to 2x reserved nodes)

We’d apply the credit contingent on HelixAI acknowledging the RCA and accepting the remediation plan (kernel pin + canary + monitoring hooks). I’m looping in Rishi and Markus for cost/precedent confirmation and Marissa for final executive sign-off.

Can you confirm which option you’d prefer? I’ll prepare the credit schedule + billing change and route to Finance/Legal.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Head, Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: helixai_latency_postmortem_v1.pdf — draft)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting production — request for remedy/credit

Thanks Lauren — quick cost/precedent note:

- The Lumina incident (2026-02) was resolved with an $18k one-time credit plus a monitoring uplift engagement; Helix’s scale is similar so that is a reasonable anchor.
- Approving $15k is fine from an ARR-to-credit heuristic, but we should tie approval to documented RCA and a sign-off from Helix that the remediation prevents regression.
- Finance prefers credits applied as invoice adjustments rather than retroactive refunds (simpler for accounting).

If the team wants to be slightly more conservative, we can offer $18k instead of $15k and require an SLA amendment clause removal if we need an ongoing remedy.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_coole <marissa_coole@redwood.ai>, finance <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden latency spike affecting production — request for remedy/credit

Lauren —

I’m okay to authorize a one-time customer concession in principle to preserve the Helix relationship. My recommendations:

- Cap the concession at $20k total (credit + short-term extra capacity credits).
- Require Helix to accept the RCA and remediation timeline in writing before we apply the credit.
- Make the credit conditional on them not pursuing SLA termination clauses in the next 90 days.

If legal wants different language, please loop them in. Finance, please confirm accounting flow for an invoice adjustment vs. contra-revenue entry.

— Markus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
